name: reasoning
description: Plan a change for review and hand-off, without touching code: analyze-requirements compares a new requirement with its previous version and tracks the open points for the PO through DoU files, leaving the epic split to split-epics in the backlog plugin; design-solution answers advice and comparison questions in the conversation, write-plan saves a plan on its own branch, and coder-handoff dispatches the approved plan to a coder subagent, reviews the branch, and opens the pull request. Meant for sessions on a high-tier model.
